meta.name: faster-and-smarter-unloader
meta.author: Foxel
meta.description:
Makes unloaders extremely fast (180 items/sec), high-performance (optimized for massive maps), and smarter.

Key features:
- High speed: transfers up to 180 items/sec.
- Highly optimized: caches topology and avoids redundant tick calculations to keep FPS high with hundreds of unloaders.
- Smart factory routing: pushes raw materials into factories and pulls finished products out.
- Same-factory daisy-chaining: feeds input resources between adjacent identical factories (e.g. rows of T1 unit factories) using a gradient balance to prevent ping-pong loops.
- Infinite loop prevention: never pulls input ingredients out of a factory to external blocks, and never loops between storage or transport blocks.
